name: homie
description: A studio in a box on your own Cloudflare: set up a studio (one repository for games, music, videos and posts) with a setup status of your accounts and tools and a step-by-step checklist, plan each game in a short interview that becomes its Game Codex (a page in the game's own look that you can read and steer, kept up to date, with the build's progress on it), build with one agent or several in parallel, make or remix multiplayer web games or make an existing single-player game multiplayer, give games sound effects and synthesized music made on your own computer for free, make songs and game scores with ElevenLabs Music on your own account, make covers and painted art with fal on your own account under a budget, give a game one coherent look as decisions you can steer and lock (a style board of three directions drawn by the game engine itself, free) with free CC0 3D models from Homie's starter library, your own models and generated props on your own fal account under a budget, every asset licensed, checked for phones and shown in a lineup at true scale, playtest a game on a computer and a phone with measured checks and a blind review, make a game run faster on phones and computers with a measured loop (frame times, CPU per frame, time to playable, downloads, memory, netplay; one change at a time, kept only when it beats the noise and the game still passes its own check), tune how a move feels in a Game Lab (one take of your working tree beside the last commit on one clock, slowed down or a frame at a time, with its named phases, graphs and sliders that write the values you keep back into the game), make gameplay trailers and music videos (captured from your game, or generated with fal under a budget with receipts) and recordings of a page while a script drives it (Play and a few moves on your game, a site walkthrough, a demo), in real time with honest frames, run the studio's site (the same sections as homie.rocks in the studio's own look, an epic landing page for every game, news posts with feeds) and public rooms (up to 32 players a room, shareable from the play page) on its own Cloudflare account (free plan, no payment method), list it in the homie.rocks directory, read the studio's own stats (counts, never tracking), and run its live games from a back office (who is playing now, in-game announcements, kick and mute, close a room, players per room, private / invite-only beta / public launch states with invite codes, and a remix switch; the owner confirms anything that takes something away with one tap). In Claude Code (2.1.287 or later) a mod adds the studio's band above the prompt, a Studio pane (the build's progress with its latest frame, live rooms with the back office, games, stats, the Game Codex, the Game Lab's last checks, parallel parts), instant commands, an arcade pane that plays a live Homie game with strangers while Claude works, holds on protected files, deploys and spending past the budget, and secrets taken out of tool output. Beta.

paneAutoOpen.title: Open the Studio pane when a build starts
paneAutoOpen.description: The Studio pane (and the parts pane, when agents build in parallel) opens by itself when a build starts, where the terminal is wide enough for a pane nobody asked for (144 columns; 110 once you have opened it). /studio always opens it.

band.title: The studio band above the prompt
band.description: One line above the prompt inside a studio: the studio, the game, the build's step and %, a Play link and how many people are playing now. Nothing outside a studio.

guardFiles.title: Hold edits to protected files
guardFiles.description: An edit to a file that studio.json "protect" lists waits for your Proceed, with its diff.

guardDeploys.title: Hold production deploys
guardDeploys.description: A deploy (homie-studio deploy, npm run deploy, wrangler deploy, studio_deploy, a media publish) waits for your Proceed, with what will change; so does a change to the studio's Cloudflare account outside its deploy (a delete, a secret, a hand rollout, a write to the live database, by Wrangler or Cloudflare's MCP).

guardSpend.title: Hold paid media calls past the budget
guardSpend.description: A fal, ElevenLabs or Tripo call that would pass studio.json "budget", the build's budget or the job's cap (or whose cost cannot be read first: a provider's own CLI, MCP server or API) waits for your Proceed, with its estimated cost; so does downloading a Clef model through Ollama (ollama pull clef-flash, about 11 GB), with its size.

redactSecrets.title: Take secrets out of tool output
redactSecrets.description: Keys and tokens (Cloudflare, fal, ElevenLabs, GitHub and others, office keys, hap_ agent passes) are hidden from Claude in every tool result; one-time owner links go to the Studio pane instead.

renderResults.title: Draw Homie's results natively
renderResults.description: Setup status as a checklist, checks as rows, playtest verdicts, deploys with their live links, and Homie's commands named in words.

arcade.title: The arcade
arcade.description: /arcade plays a live Homie game in a pane (a headless Chrome seat on this computer, paused while the pane is hidden).

pictures.title: Pictures in the terminal
pictures.description: "blocks" draws game frames as coloured character cells (every truecolor terminal); "image" draws real pixels where the terminal shows images (kitty, Ghostty, iTerm2, WezTerm).
